0x0007D8.en: 「At my level now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x000849.en: 「Guh!@　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x0008D1.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x00094B.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?」

0x0009FA.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000A32.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, geez!」

0x000B36.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@　This isn't fun...」

0x000B8A.en: 「I blew it...!@　No choice but to bail...」

0x000CDB.en: 「This is as far as I go... the rest is on you.」

0x000D87.en: 「No good, took too much damage... Retreating!」

0x000DD4.en: 「Well, I'm beaten. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E12.en: 「Kyah, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000E59.en: 「For the Granzon... to be shot down...」

0x000F04.en: 「Guh... to think I'd become a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x001040.en: 「U... ngh! So this is the end...!」

0x0010AD.en: 「Guh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0010F4.en: 「I'm sorry, the rest is up to you.」

0x001129.en: 「Damn it! Is this all my strength amounts to...!?」

0x001215.en: 「To be taken down here...@　I still have so much to learn...!」

0x001263.en: 「No good, I can't hold on! We're pulling back!」

0x0012DC.en: 「Sorry!@　I'm gonna have to pull out...!」

0x00131E.en: 「Sorry, I'm leaving the rest to you!」

0x00134D.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x00138B.en: 「Well, well, so this is where it ends.」

0x0013BA.en: 「I can't push any further. If you'll excuse me.」

0x00140D.en: 「A shame... I'll have to fall back.」

0x001445.en: 「Careless of me...@　I'll withdraw for now...!」

0x0014C2.en: 「Tch...! I can't keep it up after all...!」

0x0015AB.en: 「Ejecting...@　Ngh...! Not exactly graceful, is it...」

0x0017A9.en: 「This is as far as I go!!」

0x0017D8.en: 「So I still have much to learn...!」

0x001953.en: 「Yes. I thought it might be the trigger@　that brings your memories back.@　I've already got the captain's permission.」

0x0019E6.en: 「Ing, do you know how to pilot a@　<Personal Trooper> or an <Armored Module>?」

0x001A7A.en: 「But it's possible your body still@　remembers, even if you don't...」

0x001ACD.en: 「Of course, I don't mean right this second.」

0x001B0A.en: 「Right, it can wait until you're feeling better.」

0x001B50.en: 「I'm fine to start now.@　I want to get back the memories I lost...@　I want to know who I am.」

0x001C0C.en: 「...All right. I'll talk to the doctor.」

0x001C68.en: 「At Level F, it won't strain your body much.@　If the doctor okays it, we'll be right there with you.」

0x001D35.en: 「For the machine, I set it to the mass-produced@　Gespenst Mk-II deployed just before the <DC War>」

0x001DB1.en: 「He cleared Level C's Mission 3 - where the doctor@ stopped him - without trouble. Kill rate averaged@ 94%, hull damage just 5%...」

0x001EAE.en: 「Mission 3 of Level C... he even cleared the@　anti-air combat against the V-type Guarlion.@　In a mass-produced Gespenst Mk-II from back then.」

0x001F6B.en: 「Yes... skill enough to hold his own in the Steel Dragon Squadron.」

0x001FAB.en: 「His movements were so smooth it was almost@　something to admire...」

0x001FF4.en: 「And his body remembered all of it, then.」

0x002037.en: 「What about him - how did he seem?」

0x002068.en: 「At first he was startled, unsure of himself,@　but he settled down bit by bit...」

0x0020CD.en: 「Toward the end he was controlling the machine@　with an almost mechanical precision.」

0x002176.en: 「No...@　He can't recall when or where he learned@　to pilot or fight in humanoid weapons either.」

0x00222B.en: 「That he doesn't seem to be lying...」

0x0022CB.en: 「The machine just deployed to the Hagane -@ I told him to try it with the R-Blade Custom's@ setting.」

0x00235B.en: 「If Ing were some kind of spy, I thought@　he might show some reaction to it...」

0x0023CC.en: 「With the captain's permission, of course.@　It was only a surface-level setting, but...@　there was nothing out of the ordinary.」

0x002481.en: 「Ing's been quiet in the sickroom too...@　They say he reads the books left for him whenever he's awake.」

0x002507.en: 「Me too, how do I put it...@　That boy gives an odd impression, but@　nothing about him feels suspicious...」

0x00258B.en: 「After that, we wait for something else to@　jog his memory back, or else...」

0x00265C.en: 「Here, Mai. I brought some rice balls.」

0x0026AC.en: 「Those look good, Presia. Mind if I have one too?」

0x002739.en: 「This one's got a kombu-broth flavor to it.@　To think we can eat something like this after@　coming to La Gias, I'm grateful.」

0x0027FA.en: 「We've got similar ingredients over here.@　Seasoned the way you like it, though...」

0x002871.en: 「No complaints at all.@　You'll make a fine wife someday, Presia.」

0x002914.en: 「General Kirkus and Prince Terius!?@ Is that story true!?」

0x002989.en: 「Oh, a different story... though it doesn't@　sound like a calm one either. What's wrong?」

0x0029F4.en: 「The terms Kirkus's side set for the alliance...@ are to skip over Prince Feil and crown his younger@ brother Terius as the new king.」

0x002A9C.en: 「Ahh... so General Kirkus means to make Prince Terius@　a puppet and take control of Langran.」

0x002B62.en: 「But for that Terius to go along with@　General Kirkus's scheme...」

0x002BBE.en: 「What kind of man is Prince Terius?」

0x002BFE.en: 「He's quiet, but the sort who can't be bothered...@　He used to skip lectures, too...」

0x002C7B.en: 「So basically, he hasn't got much drive, is that it?」

0x002CC4.en: 「Well, you could put it that way.」

0x002CEF.en: 「Most likely Kirkus talked him into it.@　Feeding him nothing but what he wanted to hear.」

0x002D72.en: 「Besides, there's no way Prince Feil would just@　sit and listen to Kirkus's ravings.」

0x002DDD.en: 「But if we and Kirkus's army fight here,@　it plays right into Shutedonias's hands.」

0x002EA1.en: 「Captain, if you've gathered us, it means Prince Feil@　put in a request for us to join the operation, right?」

0x002F1B.en: 「Right, and as captain I accepted it.@ Having heard from the Prince, Masaki, Tytti and@ the rest, I understand Langran's situation, but...」

0x002FF3.en: 「Regardless of our answer, the Prince agreed to@　provide supply support to this ship.」

0x003052.en: 「It'll take time to return to the surface...@ but if we need allies in this world, I judged@ the Langran army the only choice.」

0x003118.en: 「If the Steel Dragon Squadron will lend a hand for a while,@　that's a welcome thing.」

0x0031A6.en: 「In three days, we launch a major offensive@ on Shutedonias forces at Ledna Canyon - a@ joint op with Kirkus, striking the left flank as raiders.」

0x003275.en: 「Hitting them in the side, huh. Hope it's a soft one.」

0x0032BB.en: 「If the Langran army wins this operation,@　the Shutedonias army will be forced into@　an even deeper retreat.」

0x003351.en: 「Yeah... if it goes well,@　we might just drive them off this continent.」

0x0033B9.en: 「My brothers went so far as to join hands with@　General Kirkus to plan this. We've got to make@　it succeed, no matter what.」

0x003446.en: 「...Xenia, are you sure you don't need to be@　at Prince Feil's side?」

0x0034A2.en: 「Yes. My brother told me himself.@　There are three Elemental Lords deployed here,@　so it's more convenient if I'm around.」

0x003556.en: 「Besides, I get to see the surface machines up close.」

0x003596.en: 「That's not your real reason, is it?」

0x0035E3.en: 「Also, this ship departs the royal capital at 0100@　tomorrow. All hands, be fully prepared.」

0x003652.en: 「Colonel Quaia, flying object approaching from 9 o'clock!@　It's a surface-dweller warship!」

0x0036C4.en: 「Tch, and we were so close...!@　They read our intentions?」

0x003720.en: 「No choice, we intercept! And send the 4th Company@　this way! We'll catch them in a pincer!」

0x0037AA.en: 「Judging by their heading, that unit was planning@　a surprise attack on General Kirkus's forces.」

0x003827.en: 「It galls me to end up saving him, but@　this is no time to say that...@　Everyone, I'm counting on you!」

0x0038E5.en: 「Argh, shot down before reinforcements arrive!@　As I feared, their presence could throw La Gias's@　balance out of order...!」

0x003984.en: 「This machine won't move anymore... nothing to do but eject!」

0x0039F6.en: 「Enemy craft approaching! Straight in from 6 o'clock!@　Shutedonias Elemental machines, ten of them!」

0x003A83.en: 「Captain, a group of high-speed flying objects@　approaching from 3 o'clock! Broadcasting friendly IFF!」

0x003B8F.en: 「The Vegalion...!!@　It came to La Gias!?」

0x003BDC.en: 「Sleigh! The one in the Vegalion@　is you, isn't it!?」

0x003C8E.en: 「...I see, so they had a history with these folks.」

0x003CCB.en: 「Are they cooperating with Prince Feil too...!?」

0x003D14.en: 「No, that's not it. Most likely, they're...」

0x003D4E.en: 「Oh... already finished? Just what I'd expect.」

0x003D88.en: 「The job we were hired for is done. With this, we...」

0x003DCB.en: 「I know.@　We'll see them safely home later.@　You may withdraw for now.」

0x003EE3.en: 「So that's the Vegalion... and those other units are@　the ones Ibis and Tsugumi ran into...」

0x003FB6.en: 「Why not ask the man himself?@　He's the one piloting that Galguard.」

0x004015.en: 「Yeah, good point.@　...General Kirkus, do you read me?@　It's Masaki Andoh.」

0x0040A3.en: 「Hmph... you've changed, General.@　Who is that Terran?」

0x0040FF.en: 「That's a military secret. I can't tell you.」

0x004158.en: 「General... why have you brought out Prince Terius?@　Do you want even more chaos?」

0x0041D2.en: 「I believe Prince Feil is the source of the chaos.」

0x004240.en: 「Don't give me that garbage!@　You're the one throwing Langran@　into chaos!」

0x0042CA.en: 「A pity you won't understand.@　Now, we're off to pursue the Shutedonias army,@　so we'll take our leave.」

0x004392.en: 「Well done, all of you.@　We succeeded in driving back the enemy as well.」

0x0043E8.en: 「The Shutedonias army is now retreating across@　the Nuetto Sea, with Kirkus's forces in pursuit.」

0x0044AE.en: 「He had the gall to call His Highness the source of the chaos.」

0x0044EE.en: 「He was going on about Prince Terius's coronation too...@　You really gonna let him do as he pleases?」

0x004577.en: 「Right now, driving back Shutedonias comes first.@　Without Kirkus's forces, we can't sweep the@　enemy off this continent.」

0x00465C.en: 「Masaki, stand down.@　The one most troubled by this business with Kirkus@　is Prince Feil himself.」

0x0046E6.en: 「In any case, return to the royal capital.@　I'll issue new orders after that.」

0x004751.en: 「Highness, Kirkus's army seems to have a Terran unit too.@　Could our flagship, the Hiryu Kai...」

0x0047DD.en: 「He hasn't revealed the full extent of his forces@　to us.@　We're looking into it ourselves, but...」

0x004873.en: 「If anything comes to light, please let us know.」

0x0048CF.en: 「And word on Yang Long and the others, too.@　Where the hell are they wandering off to@　at a time like this...」

0x004959.en: 「Then, Highness... we'll return to the capital.」
